{
  "phoneNote": "The oversized text-led hero pushes the distinctive radiator illustration almost entirely below the first screen, while the narrow process columns create awkward wrapping further down.",
  "desktopNote": "The radiator illustration and red–blue palette give the page a clear trade identity, but the telephone ticket and separate call button unnecessarily repeat the same action.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Compact the mobile hero with a slightly smaller headline, tighter vertical spacing and a smaller radiator illustration positioned before the supporting paragraph.",
    "Make the red telephone ticket the sole desktop hero call action; remove the separate button beneath it and the standalone call link after the service-area section.",
    "On phones, place each process description beneath its step label instead of in a narrow second column, eliminating forced word breaks."
  ]
}
